meta.format: A ledger: one line per trophy, kept like accounts. Columns are the official name, the official description, the grade, and the ledger's own note with its source.
meta.ledger: Leonida Ledger — GTA VI Trophy Accounts
meta.official: Official names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (identical on all 55). Notes are the Ledger's own, written from those descriptions. Missable entries are marked in the ledger where a description depends on one mission, one choice, or one first failure.
meta.tally: 55 entries: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation

trophies.guide: Ledger closes itself: earn the other 54 entries and this one posts automatically. Keep the book balanced stage by stage and the platinum is the final balance.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (name/description/grade); PSNProfiles (grade). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. A single debit, paid by playing the prologue to its end; nothing else is charged to this line.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: complete Chapter 1 in full. Chapter accounts settle only when every mission in the chapter is done; no side entries attach to this line.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: complete Chapter 2. Name kept exactly as PlayStation prints it, asterisks and all. Settles at the chapter's end like the other chapter lines.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (name as published); PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: complete Chapter 3. Pay it by finishing the chapter finale; partial mission progress is a part-payment the ledger does not accept.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: complete Chapter 4, last of the numbered chapters. Once this line settles, audit the missable page of the ledger before the endgame entries come due.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Gold entry: complete the final mission. Before it falls due, settle every mission-locked missable in this book; after the finale, the ledger offers no easy amendments.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (gold); PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE entry: complete Breakfast Run. The account depends on one named mission, so the ledger flags it: pay it when the story presents it, or reopen it later through mission replay.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Flag: Leonida Ledger, from the single named mission in the description.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE entry: complete The Cartel Heist, escape included. One heist, one line: settle it inside its story window or replay the mission to settle it late.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Flag: Leonida Ledger, from the single named mission in the description.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE entry: complete Child's Play. A lone named mission carries the balance; do not carry it past a point of no return unpaid.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Flag: Leonida Ledger, from the single named mission in the description.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE entry: complete Headliners during its chapter. The description names one mission only, so the ledger treats the window as the due date.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Flag: Leonida Ledger, from the single named mission in the description.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE entry: complete VCIA Takedown. While at VCIA, note the second VCIA line in this book (Catch Me If You Can) is flagged too.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Flag: Leonida Ledger, from the single named mission in the description.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE entry: complete Operation Savage Glory when offered. One named operation, one due date; replay is the late-payment route.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Flag: Leonida Ledger, from the single named mission in the description.

trophies.guide: Gold entry: bring the game's completion account to 100%. Almost every other line in this ledger posts into that total, so this is the audit at the end of the book.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (gold); PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Silver entry: 250 stunts on account. Post them in batches during exploration; the ledger's counter keeps the running total so the grind never has to be recounted.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (silver); PSNProfiles (count 250). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Entry: try each activity type once, 9 types in all. The wording charges a try, not a win, so one attempt per type settles the line.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver entry: gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Every challenge must post gold; replay any that post silver and count them off in the ledger.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (silver); PSNProfiles (count 42). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Entry: win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. A win per location is the charge; a finish without first place leaves the line open.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count 14). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: win 20 different races. Different is the operative word in the official text: the same race won twice posts once. Count distinct wins only.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count 20). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Entry: beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The account names the opponent and the contest; one win settles it, and a loss can simply be re-entered.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: complete one arcade game. Completion is charged, not a high score: choose a cabinet, play to its end, line settled. It also posts one type toward Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Entry: complete Andy's final mission. The strand is the account: work Andy's jobs in order until the finale posts; a first meeting settles nothing.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Entry: complete Kenton's final mission. Keep returning until Kenton's strand closes; only the closing mission posts this line.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Entry: complete Billy's final mission. A half-kept strand is an open account; the finale settles it and also counts toward the eight strands.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver entry: complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand must be closed in full; the five named finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are entries toward the eight.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (silver); PSNProfiles (count 8). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Entry: complete Randy's final mission. As with every strand in this book, the last job is the one that posts.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Entry: complete Tyrone's final mission. One of five named stranger finales; each closed strand also credits Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Entry: meditate at all 18 spots in Leonida. Post one visit per spot, region by region, alongside the exploration account.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count 18). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Entry: hunt the unique animal for Bret. A single named hunt, not a quota: accept Bret's job, track the animal, close the hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Silver entry: complete 3 collectible card sets. The set is the unit of account; loose cards are small change until a set is whole.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (silver); PSNProfiles (count 3 sets). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Silver entry: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Post the count district by district; the ledger counter is the memory for the long tail.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (silver); PSNProfiles (count 100). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: complete 50 challenges. Any mixture posts to the same line, so collect them during ordinary play and keep the tally current.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count 50). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Partner entry: reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner present, then lose it and escape. Both clauses are charged; a solo escape does not settle this line.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Partner entry: rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, wanted level alive throughout. Choose close shops and keep moving; letting the level lapse voids the chain.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: discover 100 vehicles. Variety posts the credit: enter vehicles you have not used, in every district, since traffic differs by neighbourhood.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count 100). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Entry: take down 5 enemies within one Combat Focus. Arrange the account before spending it: five enemies in reach, weapon ready, then trigger and clear all five inside the window.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE entry: make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The description charges one act at one airport, around the VCIA Takedown window, so the ledger flags it; free-roam VCIA is the amendment route.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Flag: Leonida Ledger, from the single location named in the description.

trophies.guide: Entry: the Rhino is a tank, and the description says it runs hot in one. Get into a Rhino (heavy wanted levels bring them out) and stay in it; no count is published, so the ledger records no count.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger, from the Rhino named in the description.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Entry: rob a jewelry store undetected. Detection during the robbery is the voiding event; plan the entry, watch staff and cameras, leave quietly. If spotted, abandon and re-enter at another store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Silver entry: rob 5 bank vaults, escaping after each. A vault without an escape posts nothing, so the exit route is part of every entry; count clean getaways only.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (silver); PSNProfiles (count 5). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Entry: rob one armored truck and escape. The escape is written into the charge, so take the load and go; one clean truck settles the line.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: explore all of Leonida, 52 areas on account. Sweep county by county and post each new area; the meditation and WAiNK lines share the same roads.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count 52 areas). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Entry: rob an illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. One posting per gang; repeat robberies of the same gang do not add to this line.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count 9 gangs). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Entry: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description names the place and the act; find the serving spot with the view and the line settles quietly.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list (ellipsis as published); PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger, from Ocean Beach named in the description.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Entry: smash out of a vehicle showroom in a car, through the glass. The exit is the charge, not a purchase: any floor car and a straight run at the window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Entry: follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, the venue the description names. Go, bowl, and complete the follow-through of the throw.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger, from the alley named in the description.

trophies.guide: Entry: deliberately vague in the official text: a partnership with mass appeal. The ledger posts no invented trigger; the plain reading points at the leads' partnership in public, so work the partner lines and record the date this one posts.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger, honest reading of the official wording only.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE entry: choices made, with PSN counting 500 behind the line. Choices cannot be amended on the same save, hence the flag: keep a spare save before major branches and make choices freely and often.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (PSN count 500). Flag: Leonida Ledger, because choices cannot be unmade.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE entry: succeed on the second attempt. The account requires a genuine first failure in its history: take a repeatable challenge early, fail once, then pass the immediate retry and post the line.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Flag: Leonida Ledger, because the description requires a first failure.

trophies.guide: Entry: witness something strange. No location is published in the official text and the ledger invents none: roam Leonida's remote edges, especially at night, and stay for the strange when it happens.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger, honest reading of the official wording only.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Entry: bowl a pedestrian over with a melee drive-by. Roll past in a vehicle and swing as you pass; one clean knockdown, like a pin, settles the joke and the line.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles. Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Entry: launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Only marked bills through contacts post to this account; ordinary earnings are a different ledger. Count in dollars.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count $250,000). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: spend $100,000 across all shops. Shop spending only is posted here, so the counter shows whether a final round of purchases is due before the audit at 100%.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count $100,000). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.guide: Entry: purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them as income allows rather than in one late lump; they also house the vehicles the discovery line rewards.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count 8). Note: Leonida Ledger.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Entry: register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, named in the description. Make registration a habit with every vehicle you keep, and the line closes early.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Ref: Exophase PSN list; PSNProfiles (count 10). Note: Leonida Ledger, from the app named in the description.
